reviews.text: Very lightweight and gentle but it doesn’t do much. I like that it absorbs very easily but there are other sleeping packs that offer better calming. Still love the brand a lot but this one is just average.
reviews.zh: 質地好輕又溫和，但就冇咩特別效果。佢吸收得好快係好嘅，但有其他 sleeping pack 喺鎮靜方面效果更加好。雖然我好鍾意呢個品牌，但呢一款只係一般。

reviews.text: I have about five different sleeping packs and this one is by far the easiest to use so far. Easy to spread and absorb and my skin feels great even in the afternoon the following day. Very stable once you’ve put it on and it finishes drying. You won’t even remember that you have it on well into the following day.
reviews.zh: 我大概有五款唔同嘅 sleeping pack，而呢款係暫時最容易用嘅一款。容易推開同吸收，就算到第二日下晝皮膚都仲係好舒服。搽完之後等佢乾透就好穩定，去到第二日都唔會察覺自己搽咗嘢。

reviews.text:
I have very sensitive, dry skin with rosacea but thankfully this mask almost immediately calms my skin down whenever it is irritated
it is very soothing and even has a nice cooling sensation to it 
will probably repurchase in the future
reviews.zh:
我有好敏感同乾燥嘅皮膚，仲有玫瑰痤瘡，但好彩呢款 mask 喺皮膚受刺激嘅時候好快就幫我鎮靜到
佢好舒緩，仲有種涼浸浸嘅感覺
日後應該會再回購

reviews.text: Nice, lightweight occlusive. I think this is perfect for oily skin or summer time routines for times where you still want a little occlusion on top of your hydrators, but can’t stand the typical ointment situation. My skin personally does terribly under heavy occlusion (rosacea and heat are not friends), but this is very light.
reviews.zh: 好嘅，輕身嘅封閉劑。我覺得呢款好啱油性肌或者夏天嘅護膚程序，當你想喺保濕品上面再加少少封閉，但又頂唔順一般藥膏嗰種感覺。我自己嘅皮膚喺重封閉下面會好差（玫瑰痤瘡同熱係唔夾嘅），但呢款真係好輕。

reviews.text: I use this as a final step after I've applied all my products . Its a gel like formula that applies really easily . In the morning my skin is moisturised. I've used other heavy moisturisers to lock in my night time routine and this is the best .
reviews.zh: 我喺用晒所有產品之後，將呢個用嚟做最後一步。佢係 gel 狀質地，好容易搽。早上起身，我塊面係保濕嘅。我用過其他厚重嘅保濕霜嚟鎖住晚間護膚程序，呢款係最好嘅。

reviews.text: I have never been disappointed by Round Lab so far, and this sleeping pack is really moisturising and long-lasting. Definitely helps with my dry skin. Only downside is that it smells a bit weird, but becomes scentless after application.
reviews.zh: Round Lab 至今從未令我失望，呢款睡眠面膜真係好保濕，而且持久。對我嘅乾性肌真係幫到手。唯一缺點係有少少怪味，但搽完之後就變成無味。

reviews.text: Great sleeping mask! The Sleeping Pack deeply hydrates without feeling sticky and absorbs well overnight. In the morning, my skin feels smooth, refreshed, and well-rested. Even works great on sensitive skin — no irritation at all.
reviews.zh: 超好嘅睡眠面膜！呢款 Sleeping Pack 深層保濕又唔會黏笠，過夜吸收得好。早上起身，我塊面摸落滑滑哋、煥然一新、瞓飽咗嘅感覺。連敏感肌都好啱用——完全冇刺激。

reviews.text: Lightweight and moisturizing. This is my go-to everyday moisturizer - day and night. I have combination/sensitive skin and this does not cause any irritation. My husband is super picky about moisturizers feeling too heavy but he loves this one too! Absorbs into the skin pretty quickly and leaves it feeling soft.
reviews.zh: 輕身又保濕。呢款係我日日用嘅保濕霜——日夜都用。我係混合性/敏感肌，用完完全冇刺激。我老公對保濕霜好揀擇，覺得厚重嘅都唔啱，但佢都鍾意呢款！好快就俾皮膚吸收，搽完好滑。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
